name: wearedge-agent-service
description: Workflow Canvas resource block prototype for calling the Wearedge edge industrial agent runtime.

parameters.name: agentHost
parameters.description: Wearedge FastAPI host, Jetson/IPC address, or API World proxy host.

parameters.name: apiKeyRef
parameters.description: Optional bearer token or WFC secret reference.

parameters.name: deploymentMode
parameters.description: Where the Wearedge Agent Runtime is deployed.

parameters.name: lineId
parameters.description: Line context for Workflow Canvas decisions.

functionBlocks.name: CallWearedgeDecisionApi
functionBlocks.description: Calls POST /v1/workflow-canvas/decision and returns JSON for data-table and Dashboard writeback.
